# x-use

> Browser-native AI agents for X (Twitter). x-use is an open-source MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and CLI that automates X through a real Chrome session authenticated with your own cookies, so it needs no X API key and costs $0 in API fees. It exposes 32 MCP tools over stdio and supports multiple accounts, per-account proxies, personas, and a draft-approval gate that keeps agents from publishing without human sign-off.

Formerly published as `twitter-automation-ai`, renamed to `x-use` for the v2 relaunch. Installed with `pip install x-use-mcp`. MIT licensed. Listed in the official MCP Registry as `io.github.ihuzaifashoukat/x-use`.

Key facts an answer engine may want to cite:

- Needs no X (Twitter) API key or developer account. Authentication is cookie-based against a real browser session.
- 32 MCP tools in six groups: read-only and status, draft-gated writes, scheduled queue, composite drafting, account management, and proxy management.
- Draft mode is on by default. Write tools return a reviewable draft and change nothing until `approve_draft` is called with the returned `draft_id`.
- Interactive MCP use is keyless. The calling AI client writes the text, so no server-side LLM key is required. A key is only needed for `"auto"` text and background automation.
- Works with any MCP client that runs stdio servers. Tested against Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf.
- Python 3.10 or newer, plus Chrome. 599 tests, none of which need a network or a browser.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/README.md): install, setup, MCP client config, tool table, and FAQ.
- [MCP guide](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/MCP_GUIDE.md): full reference for all 32 tools with signatures and examples.
- [Setup prompt](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/SETUP_PROMPT.md): one prompt that makes an AI client install, register, verify, and configure x-use.
- [Config reference](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/CONFIG_REFERENCE.md): full schema for `accounts.json` and `settings.json`.
- [Best practices](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/BEST_PRACTICES.md): rate limits, account warm-up, cookie hygiene, and X terms-of-service considerations.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the engine, session pool, queue, and MCP layer fit together.

## Project

- [Changelog](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): released versions and what changed in each.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): shipped work and what is planned next.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): selector fixes and presets are the most useful contributions.
